reason: A font customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides bundled offline font presets, user-imported woff2 fonts, persistent font selection, and a ctx.fonts registry for plugin integration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供内置字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入、字体选择持久化以及供其他插件使用的字体注册表。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with bundled font presets, custom woff2 font imports, persistent font selection, and a font registry for other plugins.

capabilities: bundles and serves local font files
loads custom fonts from user-provided HTTP(S) URLs
persists font preferences in browser localStorage
provides a font registry API for other plugins
